Hi Soojin,

Thanks for the quick reply on the onboarding form. We're excited to get the private edge deployment moving. Attached is our high-level network diagram and the list of current EIPs and subnets from our side. Some quick questions before the tech kickoff: 

- Do you support a routed VPC peering topology or do we need to set up a transit gateway?
- For private endpoints, will Redwood provide DNS entries that we can resolve from on-prem?
- We plan to take the on-prem package during the same sprint — is there a recommended ordering (networking first, then appliance install)?
- Our preferred cloud region is us-west-2; can you confirm capacity and any region-specific constraints?

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 12:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment kickoff — network diagram and questions

Hi Olivia — thanks for the diagram, that helps a lot. Quick responses inline and a proposal for next steps below.

- Peering topology: we support both direct VPC peering and TGW (transit gateway) based designs. For a small number of spokes peering is simplest (lower config surface); if you anticipate multiple spoke networks we recommend TGW.
- Private endpoints / DNS: Redwood will provision private endpoints. We provide a DNS zone you can forward to (or we can supply A records if you'd rather manage a split-horizon).
- On-prem package ordering: recommended order = connectivity (peering / VPN) -> private endpoints DNS -> test traffic -> on-prem appliance install. That minimizes downtime and isolates network issues prior to hardware installation.
- us-west-2: we have available capacity but would like to pin the model bundle and quantization profile at least 72 hours before first canary.

I'll attach a starter config template with the fields we need (IP ranges, expected peak qps, cert thumbprints, NTP sources). Can you fill and return before the kickoff?

Proposed meeting: Thu 17 Jun 10:00 PT — I can book the 60-min tech deep-dive. If that works for your infra lead please confirm.

Attachments: config-template.yaml (YAML, 2KB)

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
